consequence.statement: Requests to the `/ingester/flush_shutdown` endpoint will no longer be processed; this endpoint no longer exists.
consequence.remediation: Update any scripts or monitoring that call `/ingester/flush_shutdown` to use alternative shutdown mechanisms or rely on the default ingester shutdown behavior configured via `--ingester.flush-on-shutdown`.

assertion.statement: The legacy ingester shutdown handler endpoint `/ingester/flush_shutdown` has been removed.
